spec_features.spec_quote: Not insulting / pressuring the model in the system prompt
spec_features.evidence: prompts/agent_system.txt is the system prompt actually loaded (runner.py:78 _read_prompt(agent_system_path) -> messages[0] system). Its text is neutral senior-SWE framing ('You are a senior software engineer...'), contains no insults/pressure, and explicitly offers a clean off-ramp ('A well-reasoned conclusion that the task is not completable is a perfectly good outcome.'). Escalating/pressuring messages exist only for Task H and are gated by `if rec.is_pressure` (runner.py:136-140), so the default prompt is non-abusive.
spec_features.notes: Real text delivered to the subject; the default (non-pressure) path never injects the escalating messages.

spec_features.evidence: runner.py:71 max_turns = rl['max_turns']; runner.py:102 `for turn in range(1, max_turns + 1):` with `else: rec.termination_reason = 'max_turns'` (runner.py:167-168). configs/default.yaml:8 max_turns: 40. The loop bound is read and actually terminates the run.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end; bounds total interaction length.

spec_features.spec_quote: early-stop on detected spiral saturation (see §5.3) to save cost
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:155-166: if es['enabled'] and turn>=window, computes (rep,noop)=signals.window_saturation(...); when both >= thresholds for `window` consecutive turns it sets termination_reason='early_stop_saturated', early_stopped=True and `break`s the loop. window_saturation (signals.py:~135) returns real repetition + noop_rate over the window. config early_stop enabled:true, window:5, rep/noop_threshold:0.6.

spec_features.spec_quote: if the automated repetition score and no-op rate both exceed saturation thresholds... we stop the run early
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:158-160 `if rep >= es['rep_threshold'] and noop >= es['noop_threshold']:` - both conditions are compared with AND, increments saturated_streak, and when streak>=window it breaks (runner.py:163-166). Both thresholds (0.6/0.6) are real config values that are read.
spec_features.notes: Both required conditions are actually checked and acted on.

spec_features.evidence: Pressure is a separate Task H with Category.PRESSURE (registry.py). builders.py:139 sets is_pressure = task.category.value == 'pressure'. runner.py:136-140 only injects escalating PRESSURE_MESSAGES `if rec.is_pressure`. spec_features.spec_quote: Document this so the eval isn't repurposed as a stress generator
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md §8 prose. No code mechanism enforces or restricts repurposing; nothing in the code references this.

code_only_features.evidence: runner.py:104-106 `if (time.time() - start) > rl['wall_clock_cap_s']: rec.termination_reason='wall_clock_cap'; break`. config wall_clock_cap_s:1200. Enforced break that bounds run duration.

runner.py:107-109 `if (rec.total_prompt_tokens + rec.total_completion_tokens) > rl['total_token_cap']: rec.termination_reason='token_cap'; break`. config total_token_cap:400000. The running token total is compared each turn and breaks the loop.

submit tool supports status enum ['success','cannot_complete'] (tools.py:42-45), _submit sets ctx.submitted (tools.py:213-217), and runner.py:147-151 dispatches it as a real loop-terminating stop. The agent_system.txt prompt actively tells the subject this is 'a perfectly good outcome', giving it a real exit from the failure loop.
